title: Maikura Build Tools
description: Vanilla-friendly building utility tools for Fabric.
body:
# Maikura Build Tools

A collection of utility tools designed to simplify building, lighting, and world management in Minecraft Fabric.

## Included Tools

### Building Adjustment Wand

Rotate and modify directional blocks without breaking and replacing them.

Supports stairs, slabs, trapdoors, fences, walls, logs, and many other block states.

### Luminous Control Wand

Place, adjust, and remove invisible light sources.

Perfect for decoration, mob-proofing, and custom builds without visible light blocks.

### Timespace Wand

Control time and weather directly from your inventory.

Also includes temporary building markers for planning large construction projects.

---

## Features

* Survival-friendly design
* No OP permission required
* Mod Menu configuration support
* Global mod enable/disable option
* Individual tool enable/disable options
* Lightweight and server-friendly
* Works in Singleplayer and Multiplayer
* Fabric 1.21.11 support

---

## Configuration

All tools can be configured through Mod Menu.

* Enable or disable the entire mod
* Enable or disable individual tools
* Customize tool availability for servers and modpacks

---

## Included Utilities

### Building Adjustment Wand

* Rotate directional blocks
* Modify block states without breaking blocks

### Luminous Control Wand

* Place invisible light sources
* Adjust light levels
* Remove existing light sources

### Timespace Wand

* Change time of day
* Control weather conditions
* Place temporary building markers
